content: 第六关（后）

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  Scouting complete. I can confirm that the enemies pursuing us have been eliminated.
speaker: Dobermann
content: Scouting complete. I can confirm that the enemies pursuing us have been eliminated.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  We've managed to break through their encirclement. We'll be at the outskirts of Chernobog soon.
speaker: Dobermann
content: We've managed to break through their encirclement. We'll be at the outskirts of Chernobog soon.

raw: [name="Ace"]    Even though the enemies we defeated today were just a small portion of the whole force...
speaker: Ace
content: Even though the enemies we defeated today were just a small portion of the whole force...

raw: [name="Ace"]    At least we're safe for now.
speaker: Ace
content: At least we're safe for now.

raw: [name="Nearl"]  Thank you for what you did back there. I am forever in your debt.
speaker: Nearl
content: Thank you for what you did back there. I am forever in your debt.

raw: [name="Ace"]    Don't say stuff like that. I don't have the right to ask the Radiant Knight for repayment anyway.
speaker: Ace
content: Don't say stuff like that. I don't have the right to ask the Radiant Knight for repayment anyway.

raw: [name="Ace"]    Anyway, let's talk about that sniper, Nearl.
speaker: Ace
content: Anyway, let's talk about that sniper, Nearl.

speaker: Nearl
content: Sure.

raw: [name="Nearl"]  Putting aside the destructive power of that ballista...
speaker: Nearl
content: Putting aside the destructive power of that ballista...

raw: [name="Nearl"]  I think... he might have set up several turrets in advance, as well as other automatically-firing devices.
speaker: Nearl
content: I think... he might have set up several turrets in advance, as well as other automatically-firing devices.

raw: [name="Nearl"]  I was targeted from different directions... but I only saw one sniper.
speaker: Nearl
content: I was targeted from different directions... but I only saw one sniper.

speaker: Ace
content: I had the same feeling.

raw: [name="Ace"]    The first and second shots exploded at about the same time, but there was a noticeable delay between them.
speaker: Ace
content: The first and second shots exploded at about the same time, but there was a noticeable delay between them.

raw: [name="Ace"]    Those shots weren't fired from the same repeating ballista. At least, when we returned fire, we weren't targeting the same sniper.
speaker: Ace
content: Those shots weren't fired from the same repeating ballista. At least, when we returned fire, we weren't targeting the same sniper.

speaker: Nearl
content: Ace, did you realize something?

raw: [name="Ace"]    I can't say for sure. What if the enemy was moving so quickly... to the point of basically being in several places at once?
speaker: Ace
content: I can't say for sure. What if the enemy was moving so quickly... to the point of basically being in several places at once?

raw: [name="Nearl"]  There's no way anyone could move that quickly. I can't even imagine how it'd be possible.
speaker: Nearl
content: There's no way anyone could move that quickly. I can't even imagine how it'd be possible.

raw: [name="Nearl"]  We can't underestimate how dangerous Reunion is.
speaker: Nearl
content: We can't underestimate how dangerous Reunion is.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  It was that malicious brat who ordered the sniper to go after you. He didn't even call upon the sniper when he was attacking us...
speaker: Dobermann
content: It was that malicious brat who ordered the sniper to go after you. He didn't even call upon the sniper when he was attacking us...

raw: [name="Nearl"]  Looks like that disgusting personality of his is backed up by some real power.
speaker: Nearl
content: Looks like that disgusting personality of his is backed up by some real power.

raw: [name="Ace"]    However, he never attacked us, even when he was angry.
speaker: Ace
content: However, he never attacked us, even when he was angry.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  So either his combat capabilities are lacking, or he simply chose to not display his true abilities yet.
speaker: Dobermann
content: So either his combat capabilities are lacking, or he simply chose to not display his true abilities yet.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  Just seeing his commanding abilities in action... makes me highly suspicious.
speaker: Dobermann
content: Just seeing his commanding abilities in action... makes me highly suspicious.

raw: [name="Dobermann"]   He was commanding his troops like puppets...
speaker: Dobermann
content: He was commanding his troops like puppets...

raw: [name="Nearl"]   In any case, we're no longer in territory that he controls.
speaker: Nearl
content: In any case, we're no longer in territory that he controls.

speaker: Amiya
content: Nearl... Thank you.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  If not for your timely arrival, we would have been in grave danger.
speaker: Amiya
content: If not for your timely arrival, we would have been in grave danger.

raw: [name="Nearl"]  I was just following the plan we agreed on beforehand.
speaker: Nearl
content: I was just following the plan we agreed on beforehand.

raw: [name="Nearl"]  You were the one who asked me and Ace to make adjustments depending on the situation.
speaker: Nearl
content: You were the one who asked me and Ace to make adjustments depending on the situation.

speaker: Nearl
content: You solved your own problem.

raw: [name="Nearl"]  On my way here, I saw the extent of Reunion's atrocities, and I had doubts about their power.
speaker: Nearl
content: On my way here, I saw the extent of Reunion's atrocities, and I had doubts about their power.

raw: [name="Nearl"]  What if I stopped to engage their forces?
speaker: Nearl
content: What if I stopped to engage their forces?

raw: [name="Nearl"]  What if I helped Ursus defend against Reunion?
speaker: Nearl
content: What if I helped Ursus defend against Reunion?

raw: [name="Nearl"]  What if I stayed back at the rendezvous point, waiting for you to come to me?
speaker: Nearl
content: What if I stayed back at the rendezvous point, waiting for you to come to me?

raw: [name="Nearl"]  ...If I was the one who called the shots, there's no saying how much worse the outcome could have been.
speaker: Nearl
content: ...If I was the one who called the shots, there's no saying how much worse the outcome could have been.

raw: [name="Nearl"]  I'm not good at thinking several steps ahead. The only way I know to get what I want is to keep fighting.
speaker: Nearl
content: I'm not good at thinking several steps ahead. The only way I know to get what I want is to keep fighting.

raw: [name="Nearl"]  Amiya, I was only performing my duties, but you have the ability to end the crisis.
speaker: Nearl
content: Amiya, I was only performing my duties, but you have the ability to end the crisis.

raw: [name="Nearl"]  You earned this victory, so have some more confidence in yourself.
speaker: Nearl
content: You earned this victory, so have some more confidence in yourself.

speaker: Amiya
content: Miss Nearl...

speaker: Nearl
content: Hehe.

raw: [name="Nearl"]  This person standing next to you must be the Doctor, then.
speaker: Nearl
content: This person standing next to you must be the Doctor, then.

speaker: Amiya
content: That's right. But...

raw: [name="Dobermann"]  Every time we meet someone, Amiya has to repeat the story about how the Doctor is suffering from amnesia. What a pain...
speaker: Dobermann
content: Every time we meet someone, Amiya has to repeat the story about how the Doctor is suffering from amnesia. What a pain...

speaker: Nearl
content: Dr. {@nickname}...

raw: [name="Nearl"]   One of my friends lost her memories as well. I'm sure you two will get along.
speaker: Nearl
content: One of my friends lost her memories as well. I'm sure you two will get along.

raw: [name="Nearl"]   After all, you should understand how precious living in the present is.
speaker: Nearl
content: After all, you should understand how precious living in the present is.

speaker: Amiya
content: Mhm...!

speaker: Nearl
content: Let's get going, everyone.

raw: [name="Nearl"]  We still have to escort the Doctor to Rhodes Island.
speaker: Nearl
content: We still have to escort the Doctor to Rhodes Island.

speaker: Faust
content: Sorry... I failed.

raw: [name="Mephisto"]  No, don't apologize. It was my mistake. I lost my temper.
speaker: Mephisto
content: No, don't apologize. It was my mistake. I lost my temper.

raw: [name="Mephisto"]  Can you help me track Rhodes Island? I'll report the situation to Talulah first.
speaker: Mephisto
content: Can you help me track Rhodes Island? I'll report the situation to Talulah first.

raw: [name="Mephisto"]  She should have taken over Chernobog's core command tower by now.
speaker: Mephisto
content: She should have taken over Chernobog's core command tower by now.

raw: [name="Mephisto"]  ...She will decide the fate of these insects.
speaker: Mephisto
content: ...She will decide the fate of these insects.

speaker: Faust
content: ...Understood.

raw: [name="Mephisto"]  Be careful. Your safety is the most important thing, all right?
speaker: Mephisto
content: Be careful. Your safety is the most important thing, all right?

speaker: Faust
content: ...I will.
